mapper.sql: FROM retrip_review r JOIN retrip_place p ON p.id = r.place_id LEFT JOIN review_embedding e ON e.review_id = r.id WHERE e.review_id IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES (37.5732, 126.9898), (37.5616, 126.9827), (37.5549, 126.9867), (37.5516, 126.9876), (37.5605, 126.9889), (37.5658, 126.9906), (37.4952, 127.0850), (37.5344, 127.0941)) AS demo(lat, lng) WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(demo.lng, demo.lat), 4326)::geography, 500) )
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO review_embedding (review_id, embedding, model) VALUES
(#{item.reviewId}, #{item.embedding}::vector, #{model})
ON CONFLICT (review_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT place_id AS placeId, review_id AS reviewId, content, distance FROM ( SELECT r.place_id, r.id AS review_id, r.content, e.embedding <=> #{query}::vector AS distance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.place_id ORDER BY e.embedding <=> #{query}::vector) AS rank_in_place FROM review_embedding e JOIN retrip_review r ON r.id = e.review_id WHERE r.place_id IN #{placeId} AND length(r.content) >= #{minLength} -- "좋아요"·"친절해요"처럼 짧은 글은 어떤 질문과도 적당히 가까워서 근거에서 뺌 ) ranked WHERE rank_in_place <= #{perPlace} ORDER BY place_id, distance
